title: Source record
description: One retrieved document from an allowlisted source. This record describes the document itself; the short excerpt that supports a particular claim lives on the question that makes the claim, because one document supports many questions with different wording.

id.description: Stable identifier. Assigned once and never changed — the drift job's issue dedup key is derived from it, and questions reference it.

url.description: Canonical URL of the retrieved document. Must be on the SOURCES.md allowlist; the lint cross-checks the host.

retrieved_at.description: UTC, ISO 8601, with an explicit Z. Local time is never accepted.

sha256.description: Hash of the retrieved document. Doubles as the key of the private R2 snapshot that CI verifies excerpts against.

objectives.description: Objectives this document covers. Cross-checked against content/branding.yaml by the lint; an objective that does not exist there is an error.

snapshot.description: Where the full document is stored. Absent means no snapshot exists yet, which holds every dependent question in draft — CI cannot verify a citation it cannot read.

key.description: Object key. Keyed by hash so a snapshot is immutable by construction.

status.description: current: hash matches the last drift check. drifted: the upstream document changed and dependent content is under review.
